ValidationRule.description: This validation is used to check if product number is added when case is closed
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( ISBLANK( PMC_SS_ProductNumber__c ), OR ( ISPICKVAL( Status , "Closed"), ISPICKVAL( Status , "Closure Pending") ), ISPICKVAL( Type , "Product"), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c , "Product Request"), NOT ( OR( ISPICKVAL( Issue_Sub_Reason__c , "Blend Material Creation"), ISPICKVAL( Issue_Sub_Reason__c , "Blend Material Extension"), ISPICKVAL( Issue_Sub_Reason__c , "Straight Material Creation"), ISPICKVAL( Issue_Sub_Reason__c , "Straight Material Extension") ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Product number is required when closing this type of case
